primary_task: Inspect a repository's manifests, scripts, docs and conventions and write a concise root AGENTS.md (under 60 lines) with verified commands and references.

requirements.name: read/search files
requirements.evidence: 1. Inspect before writing: - package manager: lock files and manifests - commands: `package.json`, `Makefile`, task runners, CI workflows
requirements.basis: read files in the working directory; search them by name pattern or content (glob, grep)

requirements.name: ln (symlink CLAUDE.md)
requirements.evidence: If a Claude-compatible entrypoint is required, symlink `CLAUDE.md` to `AGENTS.md`.
requirements.basis: run shell commands on Linux x86_64

notes: Purely local reading and writing. Step 4 'Verify exact paths and commands exist' can be done by inspecting files or running local commands. No ambiguity changes the verdict.
